home.title: The autonomous AI platform for your entire growth stack
home.subtitle: VORIXA is not a brochure — it is an intelligent platform that builds websites, chatbots, phone assistants, Google review workflows, online stores, leads, SEO, and social — then runs them autonomously.
home.feature1Body: AI Website Builder, Chatbot Builder, Phone Assistance, E-commerce Builder, and Google review workflows — one connected engine.
home.feature2Body: Leads flow in from website forms, chatbots, phone, review campaigns, and quotes — scored and managed without fake CRM theater.
home.feature3Body: Need experts to ship a custom site, app, or launch package? VORIXA Studio delivers on quote.
home.socialProof: Built for founders, agencies, and enterprises ready to run on AI — not demos.

websiteBuilder.title: AI Website Builder
websiteBuilder.body: Generate and manage websites with plan-based page limits — project→website scaffolding is live; full visual builder expands by phase.

seoEngine.title: AI SEO Engine
seoEngine.body: Campaigns, audits, and keyword tracking scoped to your organization. Engine workflows unlock in Phase 3.

chatbotBuilder.title: AI Chatbot Builder
chatbotBuilder.body: Conversational assistants that capture leads into the Leads module. Conversation limits follow your plan.

phoneAssistance.title: Phone Assistance
phoneAssistance.body: Voice-agent architecture ready for telephony providers. Status stays integration_required until a provider is wired — no fake call logs.

googleReviews.title: Google Reviews
googleReviews.body: Reputation workflows: review request campaigns and AI suggestions only. Posting to Google requires a validated API — we never fabricate reviews.

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: First-class lead intake from website forms, chatbots, phone, review campaigns, quotes, and imports — real CRUD, plan-gated.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce Builder
ecommerce.body: Boutique en ligne: stores and products with real CRUD. Storefront checkout stays integration_required until Stripe Connect/store Checkout is wired — no fake sales.

business.title: Business Management
business.body: Clients, pipeline, and invoices for growing teams. Available on Growth+ plans.

social.title: Social Distribution
social.body: Multi-platform publishing architecture is ready; OAuth providers connect when each network is certified — no fake Connect buttons.

web.title: Web development
web.body: Production websites and web apps delivered by VORIXA Studio.

app.title: App development
app.body: iOS, Android, and hybrid apps scoped on quote.

automation.title: Automation
automation.body: Process automation that connects your tools and workflows.

redesign.title: Website redesign
redesign.body: Full redesigns with migration and launch support.

legal.termsBody: By using VORIXA (VORIXA.com / app.VORIXA.com) you agree to these terms. Subscriptions are billed via Stripe. You are responsible for account access and lawful use of the platform. Studio work is governed by the accepted quote or contract.
legal.privacyBody: We process account data (via Clerk), billing data (via Stripe), and application data (via Supabase) to provide the service. Analytics may use PostHog and error monitoring via Sentry. Contact privacy@VORIXA.com for data requests.

dashboard.laterPhase: This module is available in a later phase. Your plan entitlements are already tracked.

dashboard.leadsHint: Real lead CRUD. Sources: website forms, chatbot, phone, Google review campaigns, quotes, manual, import.
dashboard.leadsEmpty: No leads yet. Create one manually or capture from chatbot / quote request.
dashboard.ecommerceHint: Stores and products are real. Storefront payment checkout stays integration_required until Stripe store Checkout is wired — no fake orders.
dashboard.ecommerceEmpty: No stores yet. Create a boutique to start adding products.
dashboard.websiteHint: Real website CRUD (websites table + home page). Deploy stays planned until Cloudflare/Vercel wiring.
dashboard.websiteEmpty: No websites yet. Create one to start the builder.
dashboard.seoHint: Real SEO campaign CRUD (seo_campaigns). Audits/scores come next.
dashboard.chatbotsHint: Real tenant chatbot CRUD (chatbots table). Separate from the marketing conversion chatbot.
dashboard.chatbotsEmpty: No chatbots yet. Create one for your organization.
dashboard.gatedModuleHint: Buy the module à la carte or a plan that includes it (Billing / Pricing).
dashboard.ordersEmpty: Orders: empty until store Checkout is implemented
dashboard.phoneAssistanceHint: Real phone-assistant CRUD. Live calls stay integration_required until Twilio/Vapi.
dashboard.phoneAssistanceProvider: Wire Twilio/Vapi (or equivalent) to activate assistants. Calls and transcripts stay empty until then.
dashboard.phoneAssistanceEmpty: No assistants yet. Create a draft — telephony stays integration_required.
dashboard.googleReviewsHint: Real campaigns + requests + AI suggestions (suggestion_only). Never auto-post to Google.

dashboard.googleReviewsEmpty: No review campaigns yet. Default status: planned.
dashboard.businessHint: Clients + deals + pipeline (auto-seeded on onboarding). Invoices via /dashboard/invoices.
dashboard.roiSubtitle: Automatic real profitability per client: marketing spend vs generated revenue.
dashboard.roiHint: Revenue = paid invoices + won deals + manual entries. Profit = revenue − marketing spend. ROI % = profit ÷ marketing spend.
dashboard.roiEmptyHint: Create clients in Business, then log marketing spend to see ROI.

setup.title: Connect your engines
setup.subtitle: VORIXA needs real Clerk + Stripe keys for auth and billing. Local Supabase can be synced with pnpm db:sync-env. We never invent credentials.
setup.credentialsBody: Paste keys into apps/web/.env.local. Links open the official dashboards — copy your own test keys.
setup.clerkWebhook: Clerk webhook signing secret (optional until webhooks)
setup.supabaseUrl: Local or hosted Supabase project URL
setup.supabaseAnon: Supabase anon JWT (from supabase status -o env)
